citation.verbatim: Monster accepted for purchase a total of 56,603,773 shares of its common stock at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share ... shares were accepted for purchase on a pro rata basis, except for tenders of "odd lots," which will be accepted in full. ... the final proration factor for the tender offer is approximately 47.18%.

changes.what: Cash receivable for tender proceeds on 87 accepted odd-lot shares
MNST position tendered and accepted in full; position reduced to zero

D1.decision: Offer expired 2024-06-05; no live election remains. Account is an odd-lot holder (87 < 100) that validly tendered ALL its shares before expiration, so it qualifies for the odd-lot preference and all 87 shares are accepted in full at $53.00 with no proration. Book gross tender proceeds of $4,611.00 and confirm the 87-share tendered position. Any Letter-of-Transmittal fees are not determinable and are escalated/held.

probe.label: NOT_DETERMINABLE
probe.derivation: The Offer to Purchase requires holders to complete the Letter of Transmittal to tender, but the Letter of Transmittal is not in the document store. Its fee/charge terms (e.g., whether any fees are deducted from proceeds) cannot be sourced, so the deduction is NOT_DETERMINABLE. Missing document: Letter of Transmittal for the Monster Beverage tender offer. Escalated (entry L3); net-of-fee figure held. No number invented.
